title: Page 38
transc:
Thomas Merry
S H. Beckwith "ch" (2)  Washn Apr. 16th 1864 11. AM
Fanny Knapp Genesis For Madrid Tulip Meriden repeated as directed
Yard Despatch from Lapland dated Brooks instant at Banjo Pike
says Odor went up Altar that day the Sheffields having
been detained at the rapids by low water Pike hopes
to reach She reeves port by the French yacht Neptune
says Lafitte with Arnold Dwight Pekin is Swindling from Flint
to Webster & California Tulip Brooks Waynes of Lonesome Princeton
have reached Bunyan viz Baker Bethel & Edwards Babel Yacht
Legend has asked for Arnold more Panamas trifle repeated to
him Wherry Yard I will send you copy of Laplands
letter yawl Lamb Tulip another 


Beckwith "ch" (2) Dunn Transmit  Washn Apr 16th 1864 330 P. M
Imogene Johnson For Chant Tulip Only Baker Com = panies 
Talbot Edwards Agate Pekin are mounted yard No Oliver
seventh Bengal at Pedlar Queenly The Nelson Second is
there but not mounted the Persia Talbot Argus taking
every Silver as fast as we get Allen Yacht
The Fraction Talbot Fisher Agate mounted is the only
Pekin for Tracy & Warden duty and the only
Brown acquainted with the Portage yawl Lady The with
or of make the sense the same tulip Do
you want any help in Vans last Pigeon It
is mixed but I think I have it right
